description: Deletes a Scanner, as Delete in its editor does; the tasks it already made stay. To pause it instead, use set_scanner_on with enabled false. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying. An owner-level change: Sergio tells the owner after it is made.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

reason.description: Why you are doing this, in one sentence. The owner sees it in the notice Sergio sends after the change.

name: delete_scanner
title: Delete a Scanner
